comments.author: Kryptic-S01
comments.body_html:
Hey Nano, I have yet to try your mod but I have a question before I do use it if you wouldn’t mind me asking.

Would this mod work with the Tobii Eye Tracker 5? I know it’s a different product but I’m just curious if the mod has the same user ability as the TrackIR but for the Tobii.

Thank you.

comments.author: NanoTimmy
comments.body_html: I don’t know. I know for sure it that it works with TrackIR and Opentrack software . Google says “The latest releases of OpenTrack now support Tobii natively”, so if Tobii alone don’t work you can also try Tobii with opentrack and check if it works. This JonBons’s mod is a game changer, it really should have a lot more downloads.

comments.author: Kryptic-S01
comments.body_html: Appreciate it bud, I’ll give that a try once I get my Tobii 5 through the post. Yeah I’m surprised mods like this don’t get more attention seen as it adds a whole different aspect for the game and I didn’t realise this existed until a couple weeks ago, I was like I’m definitely trying that!
